subject: Medilabs private cluster: throughput & error spike — runbook and exec asks
messages:
From: Anya Petrova <anya@medilabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Medilabs SRE <sre@medilabs.com>; Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@medilabs.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Spike in p95 and 5xx after model swap (private cluster)

Laura,

We saw a sustained jump in p95 latency (from ~420ms to ~1.9s) and a 3.2% increase in 5xx rate starting 08:45 EDT after we rolled the new quantized model onto our private cluster. Throughput dropped ~18% while CPU/GPU utilization increased. This started right after the swap (we swapped the variant labeled q4-compat-1).

Impact: customer-facing inference pipelines are backlogging; customers reporting failures and slow responses. Attached a short diagnostics bundle.

What we need from Redwood:
- Immediate short-term remediation steps to bring error rate down (rollback or fallback?)
- A safe schedule window for a fix that requires kernel/quant config change (we're on-prem with VPC peering)
- A runbook we can follow to avoid further disruptions

Thanks — Anya

Attachments: cluster_diagnostics-logs.zip (ZIP), sample-trace-08-45.txt (log)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@medilabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 09:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx after model swap (private cluster)

Anya — thanks for the fast heads-up. We're on it and I want to ensure we minimize customer impact while keeping changes reversible.

Immediate plan (15–30m):
- Aditya and the infra team will validate whether the q4-compat-1 variant changed kernel selection or batch sizing.
- If we can immediately restore the previous variant remotely, we'll do a controlled rollback to the last known-good model (no infra change).
- If rollback isn't safe, we'll enact a routing fallback to the hosted-compatible variant to drain traffic from the private cluster while we diagnose.

I'll schedule a 30-min war-room call in 10 minutes with your SREs and our infra leads. Please share any access tokens/ssh jump details we need for the private peering.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Anya Petrova <anya@medilabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx after model swap (private cluster)

On Sun, Jun 10, 2028 at 09:32 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Anya — thanks for the fast heads-up. We're on it...

Quick tech note from the infra triage:
- Preliminary logs show an unexpected kernel fallback path triggered on quantized blocks that caused more synchronous memcpy operations; this explains the CPU climb and latency tail.
- KV cache hit-rate dropped ~25% during the rollout window — likely due to slightly different prompt canonicalization in the q4 variant.

Short-term mitigation options (pros/cons):
1) Remote rollback to previous model build (fastest). Pro: immediate recovery likely. Con: loses q4 testing progress.
2) Apply a conservative kernel override to force the older vector path (riskier; requires restart of the inference worker).
3) Route a subset of traffic to hosted-compatible variant while we warm cache (safe, adds cross-network egress).

I recommend option 1 immediately (we can script a one-click rollback). Meanwhile, I'll prepare a small runbook with exact commands and a kvcache-warmup script that Medilabs can run. Attaching runbook draft and warmup script.

- Aditya

Attachments: medilabs_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF), kvcache_warmup.sh (script)
From: Anya Petrova <anya@medilabs.com>

Access details: we granted your service account redwood-svc-cluster-admin in the Medilabs-Infra project. SSH jump host at 10.12.5.7 (credentials rotated yesterday) — I'll DM the key to Laura.

Miguel, fyi — this is the runbook the Redwood team will execute; we'll validate post-rollback metrics and run the kvcache warmup.

—Anya

Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx after model swap (private cluster)

Update summary from war-room (actions taken and outcomes):
- We performed a controlled rollback at 11:02 EDT to the previous model build (id: ml-model-v3.7).
- p95 dropped back to ~430ms within three minutes. 5xx rate returned to baseline by 11:12.
- We executed kvcache warmup across the two busiest nodes; hit-rate recovered to prior levels.
- Aditya's team will deliver a small kernel override patch and a validated q4-compat test plan; we'll schedule a blue-green rollout for the next attempt.

Follow-ups:
- Aditya to push runbook v1 to the Medilabs Drive link and add playbook steps for kernel overrides (ETA: Tue 06/12 COB).
- Evelyn to coordinate a short audit of restart impact and a post-mortem with Medilabs SRE (ETA: Fri 06/16).
- Rishi/CS to propose customer comms and any short-term credit if required (Rishi).

Thanks to the Medilabs SREs for rapid collaboration. I'll pull together a one-page exec brief for our CRO and Medilabs leadership by EOD Monday.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
